findings.observation: Test fails: 'Lighthouse.Backend.Models.Metrics.WithinSleDayDto depends on Lighthouse.Backend.Modules.FlowMetrics.Domain.ServiceLevelExpectation, ...WithinSleShare, ...WithinSleShare+Measured'. The DTO in the kernel decides the verdict and share by calling module domain code. Severity high (architecture rule red).
findings.remediation: Move the snapshot-to-DTO mapping (the verdict and share decision) into the FlowMetrics module, e.g. a mapper used by WithinSleOverTimeSeriesQuery, leaving WithinSleDayDto a plain record; or have the arch rule's owner decide an allowance; re-run ModuleBoundariesArchUnitTest.

findings.obligation: Existing pinned rule: every chart request on the Predictability dashboard is asked for without retrying and kept for no other window (retry false, gcTime 0, staleTime 0, no refetch on focus or reconnect); never show a previous answer as current
findings.observation: Two existing tests now fail: 'expected 2 to be false' at BaseMetricsView.loading.test.tsx:942 (team and portfolio). The new useQuery sets no options, so it inherits the client default retry 2 / gcTime 1.8M. Severity high (regression of a green test, slow-connection failure look delayed by retries).
findings.remediation: Give the query retry: false, gcTime: 0, staleTime: 0, refetchOnWindowFocus: false, refetchOnReconnect: false, or follow the usePercentilesOverTime state pattern; re-run BaseMetricsView.loading.test.tsx.

findings.observation: Test fails: '255 controller actions carry a guard or a marker, not 253'. Constant was moved 251 to 253 (+2) though four actions were added. Severity medium (test red; count constant wrong).
findings.remediation: Re-measure and set the constant to 255 after verifying that each of the four new actions carries its guard; owner of this arch test updates it.
